description:
Claude Code just unlocked parallel AI agents — and that's one of 9 tools Andrew Warner & Corey Ganim break down this week, including OpenAI Codex Sites, Hermes Agent, PewDiePie's self-hosted AI platform, and Replit AI for Shopify.

Presented by Zapier: https://zapier.com/

This week's roundup covers every major AI developer tools drop you need to know — fast, opinionated, and zero fluff.

Here's what's in the episode:

OpenAI Codex Sites
• Greg demos built-in auth & KPI dashboard: https://youtu.be/tUeSxXHmE9w?t=1115 | https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2061845949170045346

Hermes Agent Desktop
• Intro & hype: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tiFJmVhkF_s
• Creating sessions: https://youtu.be/tiFJmVhkF_s?si=VoCuQUvqpS1KCr1&t=75
• What it looks like: https://youtu.be/2pIihd3dpoA?si=ffReAWJDtStBa__S&t=558
• How to install: https://youtu.be/2pIihd3dpoA?si=TMqX171Kga1-ITW&t=154
• Profiles: https://youtu.be/tiFJmVhkF_s?si=FgVzG4cOcEgmoueJ&t=445

Anthropic Files for IPO
• https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2061478052257841495

PewDiePie's Odysseus
• Announcement: https://x.com/dexerto/status/2061413468549324819
• Why he launched it: https://youtu.be/rAzT5lcezPs?si=L0Rxiha4tHObtYvX&t=82
• Comparison to Claude (Test): https://youtu.be/lNyICywuyYA?si=Z5NEkjHBynxogF-C&t=297
• Comparison to Claude (Results): https://youtu.be/lNyICywuyYA?si=q5p2HxM5EtIbbqn4&t=856
• Multiple features: https://youtu.be/hv89f-zdjmk?si=vunA7WLPQKEx7tj-&t=539

Zapier Open Sources GTM Agent Stack
• https://x.com/zapier/status/2062518485024940335

Claude Code Dynamic Workflows
• Why it matters: https://x.com/trq212/status/2061907538741006796
• Nate's walkthrough: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jZgcWCzxh1I
• Agent structures deep dive: https://youtu.be/g9b9G8dcS8Y?si=agQayD5b0JHJ0ENA&t=143
• ⚠️ Burned through half a $200/mo sub in 30 min: https://youtu.be/jZgcWCzxh1I?si=rH_xJD91GbH1SJbB&t=88

Microsoft Scout
• About: https://youtu.be/I4_V8-Q7Yo8?t=46
• Examples: https://youtu.be/I4_V8-Q7Yo8?si=8kB0epAOQ-zEix0d&t=76
• Controlling a browser: https://youtu.be/PoSWJl3xWrI?t=374

Gemma 4 12B Released
• https://x.com/googlegemma/status/2062202706882883696

Replit + Shopify — Vibe Code Ecom Stores
• https://x.com/Replit/status/2062594881625940379
